newsitem.title: USA: USX-U.S. Steel had merger talks with Inland.
newsitem.headline: USX-U.S. Steel had merger talks with Inland.

text.p: The U.S. Steel Group of USX Corp said on Monday that discussions were begun early last year with Inland Steel Industries Inc about possible combinations of parts of their steel operations, but the talks were terminated after USX decided against any such move.
USX said it determined that such a combination would not be in the best interests of its shareholders and creditors, and the talks were terminated last year.
USX also said it is in no current merger discussions with other integrated steel companies.
USX shares were trading up 3/8 to 26-1/8 early Monday. Inland shares were up 5/8, to 19-1/2.
